character: Charming Haute-Savoie village, traditional farming community, good family skiing. Home of Reblochon cheese.
description: Le Grand Bornand is one of the most authentic villages in the Aravis range — a real farming community where cows still outnumber tourists. Known as the 'capital of Reblochon' cheese. The ski area (70km) is on the Chinaillon plateau above the village. Quiet, traditional, excellent value.

non_ski_activities.reblochon: Capital of Reblochon cheese — first agricultural commune in Haute-Savoie. Cheese farm visits, alpine fruitières.
non_ski_activities.chinaillon: Vieux Chinaillon — beautiful preserved hamlet with 300-year-old chalets
non_ski_activities.other: Sledging, snowshoeing, paragliding, weekly market, ice skating
